basic_info.description: Welcome to 2230 Pacific at Buchanan, an excellent block in San Francisco's sought after Pacific Heights. This one-bedroom condo truly lives like a single-family home with a clear separation of the public rooms from the bedroom area. Whether you are looking for a pied-a-terre or a first home, this beautiful condo delivers. One enters the building through a beautiful and well-maintained entrance hall; the unit is on the first residential floor just up one flight of stairs or elevator. The condo opens up into an entrance hall leading to the light filled living room which opens to a charming dining room. The newly remodeled designer kitchen has dark granite counter tops with a waterfall edge counter, cherry wood cabinets with ample and well thought out storage space and upscale appliances. A nice hall lined with closets separates the public rooms from the private bedroom and vintage tiled bath. This charming unit, presently used as pied-a- terre by the current owners, will be delivered vacant. Laundry facilities on the first floor are free for residents. Well managed building in an excellent location.
